title: The Warship That Sank On Its First Trip
description:
Vasa was a Swedish warship built between 1626 and 1628 and, when finished, one of the most powerfully armed vessels in the world. But she was dangerously unstable, with too much weight in the upper structure of the hull. In a stability test, 30 men ran back and forth across the deck and the admiral stopped it after three trips for fear she would capsize. The king was impatient and nobody dared postpone the voyage, so on 10 August 1628 she sank a few minutes after meeting a wind stronger than a breeze. She was raised in 1961 after 333 years on the seabed with a largely intact hull.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Vasa (ship)'.
